card.name: Subjects just before 'found' or 'discovered'
card.fires_on: The subject noun or its verb (was, were) in news-style sentences about something found, such as remains, carvings or a disease, right where 'found' or 'discovered' is expected next.

modes.label: Found object as subject
modes.description: A noun for an unearthed or located thing, just before the word found or discovered.
modes.example: His<< body>> was discovered not five miles from Hopewell

modes.label: Was/were before found
modes.description: The helping verb after the subject, where a verb like found or uncovered follows.
modes.example: Chronic wasting disease (CWD)<< was>> recently found in wild deer near Craig,

card.writes: It promotes words for finding and discovery in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say that something was found or discovered.
